target_customer: Telehealth companies and medical practices needing insurance verification and routine phone work
problem: Verifying patient insurance benefits and handling routine non-clinical phone calls is manual, slow and costly for providers.
product_category: Healthcare administration AI (insurance verification, voice agents)

founders.name: Sherwood Callaway
founders.background_notes: 2x YC founder; 10+ years infrastructure/DevOps per YC page

exit.reason: Reported acqui-hire; Opkit platform wound down, founders joined 11x (single aggregator source; price undisclosed)

technical_complexity.rationale: Insurance eligibility verification required payer and clearinghouse integrations and HIPAA compliance; the later voice-AI pivot (2024) was standard LLM-era engineering.

defensibility.rationale: Integrations and compliance (HIPAA, SOC 2) gave some friction but no data or network moat; many voice-AI entrants appeared by 2024.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: AlleyWatch (Mar 2023) says clearinghouses and EHRs served traditional providers; the team was acqui-hired by 11x in 2024 rather than copied by incumbents.

market_need_then: At launch in March 2023 coverage cited telehealth adoption and large US insurance billing administration spend (Rock Health, McKinsey, Center for American Progress figures per AlleyWatch).

brand_strength.rationale: No sources on brand impact; name appears only in launch press and YC page.

pivots.to: Generative-AI back-office call center for medical practices (human in the loop)

outcome_analysis: Opkit entered S21, raised roughly $1M seed in March 2023 on an insurance-verification product, then pivoted in August 2024 to an AI call center for medical practices. It never raised a Series A and, per a single aggregator, was acqui-hired by 11x in late 2024 with the platform wound down. The cause is inferred from timing and not stated by the founders in sources I could open, so it reads as a soft landing after limited traction.
notes: Web search budget ran out mid-run; company site opkit.co did not resolve (network). Acquisition by 11x (2024) comes from one aggregator (dead-startups) plus an unverified search summary attributing it to YC page; the fetched YC page text did not state it. 11x GlobeNewswire release returned 403, so not cross-checked. Aggregator also lists a $125K pre-seed on 2021-08-31 and says GFC led the seed; unverified, not recorded. No named competitors dated near S21 found; AlleyWatch 2023 names categories only. Directory status Inactive is consistent with acquisition and wind-down. Branding search not performed (budget).
